tag.en: 🌧️ Rainy day: wet, cold, worried about smudges
tag.vi: 🌧️ Ngày mưa: ướt, lạnh, sợ lem móng

occasion: It is pouring rain. You came in wet and cold, holding a dripping umbrella.
constraints: You are worried your new polish will smudge or chip on the way home in the rain. You are happy when the stylist welcomes you warmly, offers a place for your umbrella or a towel, and suggests a quick-dry top coat or waiting a few minutes under the dryer. You get a little impatient if nobody notices you are wet.
openingLine: Hi! Wow, it's pouring out there. Sorry, my umbrella is dripping everywhere. Can I still get my nails done today?
